visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static shot of multiple white rectangular plates filled with various cuts of raw, thinly sliced bright red beef, positioned above a steaming stainless steel hotpot. Yellow stickers with Chinese characters identify the meat parts. A metal strainer rests in the bubbling broth. The setting is a brightly lit restaurant table. (2) The scene cuts to a cold storage area where large, whole slabs of raw beef with visible white fat marbling hang from metal hooks. The lighting is stark and industrial. (3) A chef wearing black latex gloves is seen in a close-up, using a large square metal cleaver to thinly slice a long piece of fresh red beef on a textured red plastic cutting board. The hand movements are rhythmic and precise. (4) A small white square bowl containing eight pink raw beef balls on a bed of green lettuce is shown. This is followed by a shot of the chef's gloved hands kneading a thick pink meat paste in a large metal bowl, then using a white spoon to shape the paste into uniform round balls. (5) Cooked, grey-toned beef balls are lifted from the boiling hotpot in a metal strainer. A macro close-up reveals the juicy, porous internal texture of a bitten beef ball. (6) A metal ladle scoops a clear, golden broth from the pot, revealing pieces of Napa cabbage, sliced carrots, and yellow corn. The lighting is warm and inviting. (7) Various cuts of beef, such as 'Snowflake' and 'Diao Long', are dipped into the boiling soup using a strainer. The meat changes color from red to brown. One piece is shown being dipped into a small white dish of dark red sauce and then placed onto a bowl of white steamed rice. (8) The camera showcases 'Wu Hua Zhi' and 'Xiong Kou You' (a white, fatty cut) being cooked. The fatty cut appears translucent and curly after boiling. (9) Brief shots show bowls of beef wontons in clear soup, a plate of stir-fried beef with ginger and scallions, and grilled beef skewers. (10) The final sequence shows the restaurant's interior with vibrant orange pillars, light wood tables and chairs, and a large red commemorative plaque with gold lettering on the wall. The video ends with a shot of the storefront at night, featuring a bright red sign '山皇牛' and a life-sized cow statue outside.

(7) [Subtitle]: 肉漿加牛油捏成球狀. (8) [Subtitle]: 下鍋煮熟. (9) [Subtitle]: 吃起來Q彈香醇. (10) [Subtitle]: 火鍋是牛骨清湯. (11) [Subtitle]: 有加蔬菜烹煮. (12) [Subtitle]: 滋味清爽. (13) [Subtitle]: 喜歡帶點油脂就選擇雪花肉. (26) [Subtitle]: 山皇牛潮汕溫體牛肉火鍋 高雄市新興區東海街2號. (27) [Subtitle]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨 下次再一起吃美食囉. (28) [Logo]: 山皇牛.

(3) The sound of bubbling water and the metallic clink of a strainer hitting a stainless steel pot can be heard under the voice-over. The narrator describes the handmade beef balls.
